history.p: In 1837 Hartmann participated in Musikforeningen's competition about "den bedste Samling af 6 Sange over forskjellige nærmere bestemte Texter." His contributions were: No. 1. "Indvielsen"; No. 2. "Hvad toner gjennem Skoven"; No. 3. "Langsad Strandveien"; No. 4 "Til de Døde"; No. 5. "Lille Cathrine" and No. 6. "Flyv, Fugl, flyv". Nos. 1 & 4-6 were chosen for publication by the jury, whereas Nos. 2 & 3 remained unpublished.

annot.p: 1 bifolio containing No. 1 "Indvielsen"; No. 5 "Lille Cathrine"; and No. 6 "Flyv Fugl, flyv" of "Danske Sange". All stanzas except the first written on as many staves as needed. Above the first stave of No. 1: "Couplets" and framed: "6 Sange med Piano Forte / I:P:E: Hartmann op: 22." Hartmann later used the Op. No. 22 for "Cantate i Anledning af hendes Majestæt Dronning Caroline Amalias høie Fødselsfest den 28. Juni 1842" (HartW 151).

annot.p: No. 5 in this manuscript, which contains all six of the songs that Hartmann wrote for Musikforeningen's song contest in 1837. This copy is probably the one he handed in to prevent the judges from recognizing his handwriting, since the contributions were to be anonymous.
